rationale.input: Existing unsplit NIfTI and patient manifests; no new split or DICOM series selection.
rationale.orientation: Axis-aligned RAS physical coordinates for consistent anatomy; use the full affine, including obliquity.
rationale.reference_spacing: Per-axis median of training-patient native spacings (Med3D section 3.1). Validation/test do not fit statistics.
rationale.working_spacing: Per-axis max(reference median, largest training scan world-coordinate span/(canvas-1)). Fit whole training volumes without organ/lesion crops; coarsening is a task adaptation to memory constraints.
rationale.canvas: Fixed, GPU-benchmarked voxel box; dimensions are a project resource choice, not a published CT optimum.
rationale.oversize: Keep the fitted spacing unchanged for every validation/test patient. Expand the centered canvas to multiples of 32 when needed for full coverage; evaluate one patient at a time and log dimensions. Never silently coarsen or crop on memory failure.
rationale.interpolation: Physical-space linear interpolation, preceded by Gaussian anti-alias filtering on axes being downsampled. Single geometric interpolation avoids a second arbitrary resize.
rationale.hu_window: Clip to [-200,250] HU, the Med3D LiTS abdominal precedent, then map to [0,1]. Mapping and transfer to five-class classification/DenseNet are adaptations; other HU ranges may contain useful information.
rationale.padding: Center the full scan in the physical canvas; outside-acquisition fill -1000 HU becomes zero after windowing. No anatomy crop or mask.
rationale.augmentation: No geometric augmentation in the baseline. Preserve laterality and complete field of view without lesion boxes; this differs from Med3D pretraining and is explicitly adapted.
rationale.limits: Coverage is geometric, not proof that small diagnostic findings survive downsampling. Resolution sensitivity uses development folds only.

representation.fit_scope: each fold's training patients; refit uses selected development pool
